piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: City, procedures and public services
texto: Contextual reading of procedures and requirements at a district counter: read the exchange between an applicant and the official at a public office. Notice how the required documents (passport, photos, form) and the expected processing time are specified.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การรับบัตรคิวและนั่งรอตามลำดับช่วยรักษาความเป็นระเบียบเรียบร้อยในพื้นที่บริการ» express?

opciones.texto: Taking a queue number and waiting in order helps keep public spaces orderly.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การรับบัตรคิวและนั่งรอตามลำดับช่วยรักษาความเป็นระเบียบเรียบร้อยในพื้นที่บริการ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Official forms include clear instructions to avoid filling-in mistakes.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Assessing the satisfaction of users after receiving a service helps improve the standards of public agencies.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the interaction at the public office, at which counter must the applicant submit the documents?

opciones.texto: At counter three (ช่องสาม)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the official specifies «ที่ช่องสามนี้ครับ» (at this counter three).

opciones.texto: At counter ten on the upper floor
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: counter ten is not mentioned.

opciones.texto: They must be sent by post only
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: submission is in person at the counter.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
